'''Darth Wyyrlok's private office''' was located in the [[Temple of the Sith]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[137 ABY]] it was the site of [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok's]] meetings with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], in which the latter was offered to assume the title of [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]], and a second one in which [[Konrad Rus]] was informed that the [[Imperial Mission]] would be altered so it would spread Sith ideology to the massess of the galaxy instead of continuing the [[Victory Without War]] program.

Lord Wyyrlok was also present on his office when Regent Veed confronted the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] about his decision to [[Final Protocol|exterminate]] all life on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].
